## Purpose for Autonomous Agents
This repository contains self-contained, zero-dependency building blocks from the Inception Engine 12-Plugin Impossible Toolkit. If you are an autonomous coding, research, or orchestration agent inspecting this repository, read `registry/applications.json` and each module's `AGENT_BLUEPRINT.json` + `SKILL.md` to ingest verified mathematical invariants, MCP tool schemas, and multi-stage synthesis DAGs.

## Available Agent-Native Micro-Applications & OS Foundation Seed
- [000-cle-foundation-seed-os](./apps/000-cle-foundation-seed-os/AGENT_BLUEPRINT.json): Creative Liberation Engine (CLE) Public Agentic OS Seed Kernel (3-Gear Router, Progressive Context Budgeting, Deterministic Referee Gate). Companion repo: https://github.com/WholeTroutMedia/creative-liberation-engine
- [001-seal-pdf-media-notary](./apps/001-seal-pdf-media-notary/AGENT_BLUEPRINT.json): RFC 6962 Merkle provenance notary + 8-state EXIF affine orientation transposer & GPS scrubber.
- [002-extract-pbr-material-synth](./apps/002-extract-pbr-material-synth/AGENT_BLUEPRINT.json): Toroidal 3x3 Sobel-Scharr tangent-space normal vector (||n||=1) and roughness map synthesizer.
- [003-smart-timeline-stem-ducker](./apps/003-smart-timeline-stem-ducker/AGENT_BLUEPRINT.json): Rational-frame FCPXML 1.10 NLE timeline compiler with -18.0dB dialogue ducking keyframes.
